content.short: Cur8 provides a multi-chain digital asset display suite integrating art galleries, social networks, and marketplaces.
content.description: Founded in 2023, Cur8 is a dynamic platform for displaying digital assets and a cross-chain marketplace. It provides creators with a single, unified dashboard to list, sell, and mint collections, while enabling licensing and usage rights to be defined across multiple blockchains. For collectors, Cur8 offers advanced portfolio-management tools to link multiple wallets, organize and filter holdings, and create immersive display experiences for prized pieces, delivering a distinctive way to showcase digital art.
content.meta: Founded in 2023, Cur8 is a dynamic digital asset display platform and marketplace. Discover Cur8 and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
